children: Invesco Asia Dragon Trust plc announces that on 22 September 2026, it repurchased 125,000 ordinary shares of 10p each (‘ordinary shares’) at a price of 509.00p per share, to be held as Treasury Shares.
The total number of ordinary shares held in Treasury following this repurchase is 19,420,594.
The total number of ordinary shares remaining in issue (excluding 19,420,594 ordinary shares held in treasury) is 198,199,151.
For and on behalf of Invesco Asset Management Limited
Corporate Secretary to Invesco Asia Dragon Trust plc

title: Transaction in Own Shares
